_comment: Enforcing regression gate on paige's DETERMINISTIC engine counters. Unlike wall-clock, render/segments are O(screen): exact at a fixed 24x80 tty and constant across file size, so a blow-up means an algorithmic regression (e.g. wrap going O(line) again). 'seen' is the measured value at a 1 MiB smoke corpus (identical at 64 MiB, see BASELINE.md); 'max' is the gate. Re-record by running bench/check.sh --show and bumping the maxes with headroom. search_* counters are intentionally NOT gated -- they scale with corpus/codebase size.
